title: Astra (max)...
author: master_internutter
selftext: I'm starting to wonder if opus 5.5 trained extra hard on blender or something because it seems about twice as good as Astra at the moment

comments.author: InstructionNo3616
comments.body: It’s better at architecture or geometrical shapes. Something like this I would use tripo/meshy/image to 3d model

replies.author: master_internutter
replies.body: I don't have a picture at the moment as I'm lying in bed but the human models opus did for me yesterday actually looked pretty good, there was still weird things like they had big butts and were unproportional but the face actually looks really good

replies.author: InstructionNo3616
replies.body: It’s a pipeline problem and not a model problem. Wasting tokens using the wrong tool.
